nodes.name: Backend as Source of Truth

properties.rationale: Neon PostgreSQL is the authoritative data store. Expo app is UI layer only. TanStack Query provides client-side cache. SQLite is optional offline fallback (Phase 2).
properties.direction: Neon PostgreSQL -> Hono Backend -> Expo App -> TanStack Query cache

nodes.id: concept:Architecture Decision:Backend as Source of Truth

properties.rationale: Keep it simple. Assume users have internet. Use TanStack Query for caching. Add SQLite in Phase 2 if needed. The 3-5 friends always have internet.

Free, open-source (MIT), TypeScript-first, works with Hono, session management out-of-box, Drizzle ORM integration, HttpOnly cookies, argon2 hashing, production-tested. Handles password hashing, session tokens, CSRF protection automatically.
Lightweight, TypeScript-native, works with Vercel Edge Functions, excellent DX with middleware pattern
Type-safe, no migration pain, works with Neon PostgreSQL, integrates with Better Auth adapter
Serverless, generous free tier, connection pooling, excellent for small-scale apps with growth potential
Hono-native deployment target, fast cold starts, auto-scaling, free tier for 3-5 users (100k invocations/month)

properties.rationale: Seamless onboarding - user doesn't need separate profile setup
Balance between security and UX - long session for mobile app, auto-refresh for active users
Simpler than username search. No personal info shared. Easy to share verbally.
Near real-time social awareness without excessive backend load. TanStack Query handles refetchInterval.
Single endpoint updates progress, streak, and unlocks next day atomically
Prevents XSS attacks. Mobile apps can't be exploited via cookie theft like web apps.
Industry-standard password hashing, resistant to GPU-based brute force attacks
